text: You there, {name}! Every hand helps. Dig clay, bake it, and stack the bricks on the tower.

text: Higher! Always higher!

speaker: The builders
text: Come, | let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens, that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.
They wanted to make a great name for themselves, instead of honoring God's name.
Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.

speaker: The LORD
text: If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them. Come, let Us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech.

speaker: Builder
text: One more row today!

speaker: Builder
text: From up there you will see the whole world.

speaker: Builder
text: Bricks! We need more bricks!

speaker: Builder
text: Gorra fen tikka? Mo mo zandu! Plif?

speaker: Builder
text: Ulla brek-brek! Shonna wib dap!

text: Tavi? Tavi nok? Zem-zem farrabo!
